newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank sees no more acquisitions for now.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank sees no more acquisitions for now.

text.p: NationsBank Corp chief executive Hugh McColl Jr. said Friday he does not expect to make any more acquisitions in the near-term after a planned $9.5 billion acquisition of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc.
"We have no interest in acquisitions in the near-term," McColl said in a news conference here about the Boatmen's deal.

But Charlotte, North Carolina-based NationsBank could use Boatmen's as an entry to expand in the West in the future, though the 61-year-old McColl indicated he might not be leading NationsBank when that happens.
"It may well be younger people that lead us further west, but in any event, I'm sure we will go there some day," he said.
